content: Why os.replace can fail on Windows: CPython opens files without FILE_SHARE_DELETE, so replacing (MoveFileExW REPLACE_EXISTING) a destination that another process/thread currently holds open raises WinError 5 (ERROR_ACCESS_DENIED, the common one when a plain reader holds the target), WinError 32 (sharing violation, source temp held), or 33 (byte-range lock). errno maps to EACCES. Fix: close reader handles promptly (read file, parse, close - never hold open), keep atomic tmp+os.replace writes, and if contention is possible retry with small jittered backoff treating {5,32,33} as contended-replace. In-process reader threads can collide with writer threads too - a single json.load(...).close-in-with pattern is safe; long-lived handles are not.
